column1: ANTIFUNGALS
• Avoid diluting Amphotericin B in NS 0.9%. (Flush line with D5% only)
• Administer Voriconazole, SUBA Itraconazole, and Solution Itraconazole on empty stomach
• Administer Tablet Itraconazole and Tablet Posaconazole with acidic beverages
• TDM recommended for Voriconazole, Posaconazole, Isavuconazole for appropriate dosing
• When treating oral candidiasis, administer 50-200 mg orally dispersible tablet. Place the tablet in
the buccal region and allow it to dissolve without swallowing OR disperse the tablet in water, allow
the sips to rinse the mouth and then swallow
• Use protection with gloves while handling Voriconazole tablets
ANTIVIRALS
• Confirm viral infections via PCR before starting antivirals
• Maintain appropriate records of pre-emptive antiviral therapy
• Start within 48 hr of symptoms to maximize effectiveness
• Ensure adherence to the regimen
• Provide sufficient hydration for Acyclovir and Valacyclovir
• Use protection with gloves while handling Valgancyclovir
ANTIMALARIALS
• Confirm diagnosis via microscopy/rapid diagnostics
• Ensure full course adherence
• Use Artemesin based combination for uncomplicated malaria based on local resistance
• Follow WHO and NVBDCP guidelines for prevention and treatment of Malaria
ANTITUBERCULAR
• Discourage empirical ATT- start only after confirmation or strong suspicion of TB presence
• Contact Microbiology- TB Lab for drug resistance/genomic sequencing
• Standard 1st line ATT dosing = Isoniazid: 5mg/kg, Rifampin 10 mg/kg day, Pyrazinamide 15-25 mg/kg,
Ethambutol: 15-20 mg/kg
• Administer Rifampicin on empty stomach
• Monitor for LFTS as routine
ANTIPARASITES
• Follow WHO and NVBDCP guidelines for prevention and treatment
• Ensure targeted treatment on confirmatory diagnosis
• Promote hygiene and sanitation
